summary: This directory centralizes the persistence and repository abstraction for gyomu-related domain entities, acting as the bridge between business logic and the underlying database layer.
responsibilities: Providing service layers for gyomu entities
relationships: The repository layer provides service access to persistent gyomu data for higher-level business components.
The use of dependency layers allows the application to inject specific data access implementations into the broader system.
designDecisions: Utilization of service layers to abstract database persistence
Implementation of dependency injection via layer containers
